comments.subject: Public Comments
comments.comment: Regarding the recent email survey from Y2Analytics and support for Tech Ridge: The survey asks what the residents currently know about Tech Ridge, then proceeds to give short statements about what the development will do for the city in terms of money, jobs, housing and water conservation; followed by a question asking if this information changes the resident's view in any way. This survey gives a minimal amount of information for which to base an opinion on and I feel the answers cannot be complete without knowing what the level of St. George city's involvement, investment and committed resources are. You're only telling a small part of the story.

notes: Scanned JotForm-style public comment submission. Contact info redacted.
